artworks.title: Abraham Going to Sacrifice Isaac
artworks.description: The image is a woodcut print depicting two figures and a donkey. One figure is an older man holding a book or a scroll, while the other is a younger person carrying a bundle of sticks. The woodcut technique uses bold, dark lines to show texture and depth. The setting includes a detailed tree to the left, a rocky landscape, and a low horizon line. The color palette is monochrome, with black ink on a lighter background. In the distance, there are more figures, a building, and a sky with clouds and birds.

artworks.title: Arthur, Charles the Great (Charlemagne), Godfry of Bouillon
artworks.description: This is a drawing of four armored and elaborately decorated horsemen. The drawing depicts four knights dressed in detailed armor, riding horses that are also adorned with ornate coverings and feathered plumes. The knights seem to be part of a procession or tournament, with the horses poised elegantly, and the wind appearing to rustle their cloaks and banners. Above each knight are scroll banners with inscriptions.

artworks.title: Joshua, David, Judas Maccabees
artworks.description: The image shows three ornately dressed figures on horseback, accompanied by banners with inscriptions. The scene depicts a procession emphasizing detail and intricacy in attire and horse decorations. Each figure is adorned with elaborate feathered helmets and armor, while the horses wear decorated caparisons. The style reflects early woodcut techniques, with bold lines and careful attention to linear details that give volume and texture to the figures and horses.

artworks.title: Hector of Troy, Alexander of Macedon, Julius Caesar
artworks.description: The image shows three individuals on different animals. The leftmost figure, "Hector Trojanus," is on a horse. The middle figure, "Alexander Macedon," is on an elephant. The rightmost figure, "Julius Caesar," is on a horse.

artworks.title: Self-Portrait
artworks.medium: drypoint in black on wove paper
artworks.description: The image shows a three-quarter view portrait sketch of a man seated. He has a bald head, a thick mustache, deep-set eyes, and a serious expression. The man is wearing a suit jacket over a vest and a tie, with a visible shirt collar. His right hand rests on his knee, and the left hand is partially seen resting on a surface. The background is blank.

artworks.title: Palazzo d'Oro
artworks.description: The image shows a view from the water of an ornate building with arched windows and intricate patterns. The horizon is not distinct, with the lowest level of the building roughly aligning with it. Gondolas are on the water, each piloted by a gondolier. The brushstrokes are fine and layered, creating texture and atmosphere. The color palette is monochromatic, with shades of sepia and gray. Light and shadow play across the water and building.

artworks.title: Guidecca Canal
artworks.description: The image shows a seascape with several boats and ships from a water-level perspective. A small boat with a figure is closest to us, while a larger ship with grand masts dominates the center-right. Other smaller vessels, including a rowboat with a figure, are scattered around. The background features a distant shoreline with more ships and possibly urban structures. The color palette is soft sepia, with gentle ripples on the water's surface.

artworks.title: Ponte Conarreggio
artworks.description: The image shows a stone bridge over a calm canal. Buildings of various heights line the canal, leading into the distance. Delicate brushstrokes depict the details of the buildings and water. The color scheme is sepia, creating a warm atmosphere. Gondolas are docked by the canal banks, and figures are seen on the bridge and the path beside the water. The background features urban buildings with ornate facades and windows.

artworks.title: Gondoliers
artworks.description: The image shows a tranquil body of water with three gondolas moving along it. The view is slightly elevated, offering a clear perspective of the scene. In the background, there are distant architectural silhouettes, indicating the presence of a city or large structures. The brushstrokes are fine and delicate, resembling etching or engraving techniques. The color palette is monochromatic, mostly sepia or soft beige tones. The gondolas are detailed, with reflections on the water's surface. In the distance, buildings are faintly visible against the soft horizon.

artworks.title: Christ and the Adulteress [recto]
artworks.medium: pen and brush and black ink with brush and gray ink and gray wash heightened with white on gray prepared paper
artworks.description: The image shows a drawing with several figures. In the center, a woman is kneeling, with her body slightly turned to the left, and arms extended outward. She has elaborate hair embellished with decorations and wears a long, flowing garment. Behind her, several standing men are depicted, one with a halo. The background features a mountainous landscape with trees, a path, and buildings or hills. The scene is depicted in monochrome colors.

artworks.title: Abraham Entertaining the Angels [verso]
artworks.medium: pen and brush and black ink with brush and gray ink and gray wash heightened with white on gray prepared paper
artworks.description: This is a painting of a rural scene with multiple figures and animals. The composition features a group of individuals engaged in interaction in the foreground near a structure, while in the background, there is a pastoral landscape of hills, trees, and several shepherds tending to flocks of sheep by a stream or road. The figures are depicted in traditional garments with one kneeling. The artwork uses a monochromatic palette with shades of grey to create contrasts and highlights. This is in the style of a Renaissance artist, reminiscent of detailed narrative compositions seen in works by Pieter Bruegel the Elder or other artists of the time who focused on human activity and landscapes.

artworks.title: Martin Luther
artworks.dimensions: sheet (trimmed to plate mark): 25.8 x 17.2 cm (10 3/16 x 6 3/4 in.)
artworks.description: The image depicts a man seated behind a desk. He has rounded facial features and short, curly hair. He wears a dark robe with fur trim and holds a writing quill over an open book. Closed books are to his left and documents to his right. The background is plain with Latin text, a coat of arms, and a monogram signature in the scene.

artworks.title: Jan Lutma the Elder
artworks.medium: etching with punch engraving on laid paper
artworks.description: The image shows a man from the waist up. He is seated and angled to the side. His facial features include a furrowed brow, a prominent nose, and a thick, full beard. He wears a cap that covers his head and a heavy coat with a fur-trimmed collar. A textured scarf or garment is visible under the coat. In one hand, he holds small objects, possibly tools, while the other hand rests on papers or documents. The background is plain and textured, drawing focus to the subject. The name "IOANNES LUTMA AURIFE" is inscribed at the bottom of the image.

artworks.title: Christ lead to Prison
artworks.description: The image shows multiple figures from the waist up, with one central figure being focused upon. The central figure is seated and has long dark hair with facial markings or wounds visible, and is wearing a brown robe. This figure is surrounded by other standing figures, some wearing garments in red, blue, and yellow, with hoods and hats on their heads. One figure is raising their arm near the central figure's head, another holds a flag with a symbol, and one figure holds a club. The figures are closely grouped together. The central figure appears to have a golden circular halo. The background shows a landscape with abstracted greenery and sky elements.

artworks.title: Animal Legend (Tierlegende)
artworks.description: The image features a series of intricate and flowing lines in an abstract composition. These lines suggest the presence of several animals, including what resembles a rabbit, a rodent-like creature, and an antelope with long, curved horns. Additionally, there are elements that may be reminiscent of vegetation, with leafy and organic motifs. The interconnected abstracted elements create a dynamic and intertwined scene.

artworks.title: The Man in the Tall Hat
artworks.description: The image shows a person sitting on a bench. The person is positioned sideways with their torso and face slightly turned towards the viewer. They are wearing a tall top hat that partially shades their face, draped in a cloak or cape covering most of their upper body. Their lower legs are visible, covered in light-colored pants, with dark shoes. The background is a wash of muted tones with no distinct scenery.

artworks.title: The Absinthe Drinker (Le buveur d'absinthe)
artworks.description: This print depicts a man seated on a low ledge. The man is wearing a top hat that covers his hair and a cloak that drapes over his shoulders and extends down to his knees. Below the edge of the cloak, he wears pants and dark shoes. The man’s face is slightly turned to the right, and we can see wide eyes, a small nose, and thin lips. The man casts a shadow on the wall behind him, and a bottle is lying on its side in front of him, near the bottom-right corner. The background is filled with sketchy, crosshatching lines on the off-white paper.

artworks.title: Dead Christ with Angels (Christ aux anges)
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a central figure surrounded by two angelic beings. The central figure appears serene or sorrowful, while the angels are depicted in supportive poses. The scene conveys a somber atmosphere, with dark shadows in the background. The wings and drapery are detailed with intricate line work.

artworks.title: The Toilette (La toilette)
artworks.description: The image shows a person seated with legs bent at the knees, holding a draped fabric across their chest. Their upper body is turned towards the viewer. The person has dark, centered eyes, a neutral expression, and hair that is parted in the middle and pulled back. They are wrapped in a cloth covering their lower body but leaving shoulders and arms bare. In the background, another figure appears to be standing, with a partially obscured face, engaging in an activity near water. The background has a textured, intricate pattern with shadows, adding to the overall aesthetic of the scene.

artworks.title: The Smoker (Le fumeur)
artworks.description: The image portrays a person in an upper body view holding a long-stemmed pipe to their mouth. The etching shows the person with a full beard and distinct facial features, wearing a thick cap and a single-breasted coat. The individual's hand is raised, holding the pipe. The background is plain.

artworks.title: Civil War (Guerre civile)
artworks.description: This is a print showing an outdoor space filled with debris and a person lying on the ground. In the background are vertical shaded sections, suggesting tall buildings or structures. Closer to us, a low wall crosses the scene horizontally, appearing to be made of bricks or stones. The ground near us is scattered with debris, including what looks like an overturned barrel near the bottom left corner. In the center, a man lays on his back on the ground. He appears to be wearing a dark suit and a black bowler hat and has light skin and a white mustache. In the bottom right corner, another pair of legs is visible, with dark shoes and striped trousers. “

artworks.title: At the Prado (Au Prado)
artworks.medium: etching and aquatint on machine-made laid paper
artworks.description: The image shows three women in a full-body view, with the central figure prominently displayed. The women are standing, with the central figure positioned slightly facing the viewer. Their facial features are suggested with minimal details, giving them soft, indistinct appearances. The hair of the central woman is partially visible under a dark hood or head covering. All three women are dressed in long, dark garments that cover them completely. The central woman appears to be clutching a small bag with gloved hands. Around them are other figures and possibly a dog at their feet, sketched with minimal details. The background includes faint outlines of other individuals, shaded areas that suggest trees or bushes, and a textured sky. The overall tone is dark, with a warm monochromatic palette.

artworks.title: The Reader (Le liseur)
artworks.description: The image shows an older man seated and reading a large open book before him. He has a white beard and mustache, with slightly long white hair covering his ears. He wears a dark jacket over a white collar shirt. He is leaning forward slightly, holding the book with one hand while the other rests on the page. The background is a richly etched pattern.
